footprint.heading: Industrial Skylight & Roof Ventilation Supplier for South Africa
paragraphs: Dura Plast is a skylight manufacturer South Africa factories, warehouses and commercial developers turn to for daylighting and roof ventilation. As an industrial skylights South Africa supplier, our RHINO TUFF range — skylight domes, barrel vaults, tubular skylights, polycarbonate roofing and turbine ventilators — is matched to local roof profiles and climate. We work with industrial shed and PEB contractors, supplying roof accessories for PEB buildings South Africa, and prepare technical data and pricing for roofing tender South Africa skylights submissions. As a commercial skylight supplier and skylight manufacturer for hotels, shopping centres and offices, we also support architects and developers as a skylight supplier South Africa can specify with confidence. We quote and deliver for projects across South Africa, including Cape Town, Johannesburg, Pretoria and Durban.

South African roofs face long hours of direct sun, sudden summer storms and, on the coast, salt-air corrosion. A skylight or roof sheet not built for these conditions fades, leaks or cracks within a few seasons. Our polycarbonate and FRP products carry UV-stabilised layers and are matched to standard IBR and corrugated steel profiles, so they seal properly from day one. Pairing a skylight with a turbine or hybrid ventilator also cuts daytime lighting and cooling costs for warehouses and factories.

As the manufacturing partner behind many a skylight installation contractor's project, we supply curbs, ventilators and skylight domes pre-matched to standard pre-engineered roof spans, so nothing needs reworking on site. For a roofing tender South Africa skylights submission, we prepare technical data sheets, load specifications and B2B pricing so bids go in with accurate numbers.

Beyond industrial roofs, barrel vault and dome skylights bring even natural light into hotel atriums, lobbies and shopping centre walkways while meeting the wind and water-load specifications architects require. Our Light and Air range pairs a skylight with a turbine ventilator in a single roof opening, useful for hospitality buildings as much as factory floors.

faq.q: What is a skylight and what types are used in South Africa?
faq.a: A skylight is a rooflight that lets daylight into a building. Common types are dome skylights, flat roof skylights, barrel vaults, tubular skylights (solar tubes) and polycarbonate sheeting rooflights for steel and IBR roofs.

faq.q: How much do skylights cost in South Africa?
faq.a: Skylight prices vary widely with type, size, roof type, quantity and installation. Send your specifications and we will quote.
Leaks usually come from poor flashing, curbs or sealing, not from the skylight itself. A correctly sized roof curb and proper installation prevent this. We supply FRP and polycarbonate roof curbs.

faq.q: Do skylights make a building hotter?
faq.a: Clear glazing lets in heat as well as light. Tinted or opal glazing and roof ventilation help. Our Light and Air combos pair a skylight with a turbine ventilator to extract hot air.

faq.q: Do you supply skylights and roofing in Cape Town and Johannesburg?
faq.a: Yes, we quote for projects across South Africa, including Cape Town, Johannesburg, Pretoria and Durban. Add your site location to the quote form.

faq.q: How do I get a quote?
faq.a: Send your project details (size, quantity, site location) through the Get a Quote form and our team will reply with a B2B quotation.
